results.sql: SELECT formula FROM mp_entries WHERE lattice_a < 5 LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT e.formula
FROM mp_entries e
JOIN mp_element_ratios r ON e.entry_id = r.entry_id
WHERE r.element = 'Ni'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS stable_entry_count
FROM mp_entries
WHERE energy_above_hull = 0
LIMIT 10000;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) AS element_type_count FROM mp_elements LIMIT 10000;

SELECT crystal_system, COUNT(*) AS material_count
FROM mp_entries
GROUP BY crystal_system
ORDER BY material_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS material_count
FROM mp_entries
WHERE chemsys = 'Al-Ni'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT formula
FROM mp_entries
WHERE volume IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.formula, e.energy_above_hull
FROM mp_entries e
JOIN mp_element_ratios r ON e.entry_id = r.entry_id
WHERE r.element = 'Co'
ORDER BY e.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (chemsys) chemsys, formula, energy_above_hull
FROM mp_entries
WHERE chemsys IS NOT NULL
  AND energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY chemsys, energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cubic_materials_with_band_gap_gt_1ev
FROM mp_entries
WHERE crystal_system = 'Cubic'
  AND band_gap > 1
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT formula, band_gap
FROM mp_entries
WHERE chemsys = 'Co-Ti' AND band_gap IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY band_gap DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(e.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull
FROM mp_entries e
JOIN mp_element_ratios r1 ON e.entry_id = r1.entry_id
JOIN mp_element_ratios r2 ON e.entry_id = r2.entry_id
WHERE r1.element = 'Co'
  AND r2.element = 'Ti'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT crystal_system, AVG(band_gap) AS average_band_gap
FROM mp_entries
GROUP BY crystal_system
ORDER BY AVG(band_gap) DESC
LIMIT 10000;
